Sally Yeh Promotional Portrait

Sally Yeh appears in a professional studio portrait wearing a sheer black blouse and ornate earrings. Her dark, wavy hair frames her face as she looks upward with a poised expression. The neutral gray background and soft lighting emphasize her features and the delicate fabric of her outfit, creating a refined promotional image for her LINE MUSIC artist profile.

This photograph is used on LINE MUSIC’s artist page for Sally Yeh, showcasing her as a prominent singer. The image aligns with the page’s focus on her albums, songs, and biography, serving as a visual introduction to her musical catalog.

sources.description:
Sally Yeh’s 1986 Mandarin Greatest Hits Album Cover

Sally Yeh appears in a relaxed pose against a stark white backdrop, wearing a cropped white blouse and low-rise blue jeans that reveal her midriff. Her dark hair frames her face as she offers a gentle smile. The cover prominently displays her name in both English ("SALLY YEH") and Chinese ("葉蒨文"), along with the album title "女人的弱點" ("A Woman’s Weakness").

Released in 1986, this album compiles 15 of Sally Yeh’s Mandarin hits, totaling 1 hour and 4 minutes. The minimalist design emphasizes her casual style and approachable image, reflecting the pop sensibilities of the era.

sources.title: 葉蒨文變身霸氣女強人 - 東方日報
sources.description:
Sophie的霸氣女強人造型

藝人葉蒨文（Sophie）近日在無綫戀綜《女神配對計劃》中以清純形象吸引大批粉絲，並經常在社交平台分享甜美可人的照片。近期，她發布了一段全新造型影片，徹底顛覆以往的公主風格。

影片中，Sophie將劉海梳起，採用微濕髮效果，妝容銳利精緻，搭配一套剪裁利落的白色西裝，整體造型幹練而霸氣。她全程面無表情，對鏡頭擺出型格姿勢，展現出強烈的自信與氣場，令粉絲驚呼「這還是Sophie嗎？」

sources.description:
Sally Yeh Promotional Portrait

Sally Yeh appears in a studio portrait wearing a simple black camisole against a light, neutral backdrop. Her straight, dark hair and composed expression convey a sense of calm confidence and professional poise. This image is used on her Apple Music artist page, where listeners can find her popular songs and albums, including 《情人知己》 and 《祝福》.
